test_align_target_labels: test align_target_labels to reorder target values by label vocabulary index order
test_pad_nested_lists: test pad to right-pad nested lists of unequal length with a pad token
test_pad_with_shape: test pad with an explicit pad_shape to produce a fixed-size padded output
test_vocab_builder: test VocabBuilder to build a vocabulary from tokens and truncate by count or size
